Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner directed the WebSurfer to the wrong Discogs master release (ID 1264847), which is a short sampler/highlights entry with 8 tracks, instead of the actual Back to Mono box set master listing (e.g., Discogs master 253925 or the Wikipedia box set page). This mis-selection led to concluding the first track was “Every Breath I Take” and created a false mismatch with the tombstone-inspired song, derailing the investigation despite correct sources being available in earlier search results.
